rationale: PINS the M14.1 route-detection fix: pinned kotlin wasm exposes ZERO named fields, so annotation arguments required positional + leaf-modifier-text fallbacks. Previous expectations 'GET /users'/'POST /items' reflected the deprecated method-prefixed format.
